notes.title: Halloween v0.3 Update!
notes.content:
Halloween is just near, so go and play our new zombie gamemode to get the right mood for the weekend!
In the new update we added one map "Old town" that will bring you to a dark place full of undead. Also, new gamemode, a new oppurtunity to play with your friends and to kill zombies together. PvE system that will make you to fight for your life!
Also some minor fixes:

    Added hints in menu, so it's easier to navigate
    Changed in-game timer, so the game starts just right after the first player choose the team

Scary Halloween!

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
Finally, 0.2.0 is out!

First of all, this patch was created to fix multiple connection issues faced by a lot of players. Now everybody can host his own server and connect to other's servers over the Internet.

MInor fixes:

Remastered team selection menu
Raised run speed by 1.7
Improved quality of projectiles' synchronization
Fixed problems with CTF flag tracking


Play and have fun!

notes.title: Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
So, our first little update with some hotfixes.

    Fixed player camera position
    Fixed bug when head or hand can go through wall
    Fixed player movement after round ending
    Fixed ability to move if you die right at the end of the round and spawn after the timer's end.
    Added version checker when connecting to server
    Added 10 second period before start of the round
    Added some hints in server creation menu for more comfortable orientation
    Added some glowing elements to player's equipment for better visibility
